name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Blood's Curse) — 2 Intermediate — Abated Tooth

system.description: By winning a Mental versus Physical Challenge, the thaumaturge mystically blunts the target's fangs, robbing her of the ability to use them to cause aggravated damage or to feed normally; even a successful bite will no longer trigger the ecstasy of the Kiss. This power lasts an entire night. This path may only be learned by Kindred of 10th generation or weaker, and its powers only function against vampires of equal or better generation. It retests with the Occult Ability.
